set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_HEAD=782d53a7f6203bf31b3435a4ad91711efc21a1b3
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
status = subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'], text=True).splitlines()
paths = {line[3:] for line in status if len(line) >= 4}
expected = {'scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py','tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py'}
assert paths == expected, (paths, expected, status)
observer = Path('scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py').read_text()
assert 'H_SAFETY_CLEAR_REASONS = frozenset(' in observer
assert 'def is_h_safety_clear(' in observer
assert observer.count('is_h_safety_clear(safety, force, reason)') == 3
assert 'reason == 0' not in observer
test = Path('tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py').read_text()
assert 'test_h_safety_clear_accepts_safe_and_timer_off' in test
assert 'for reason in (2, 3, 4, 5):' in test
print('STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V2_PRECHECK_PASS')
PY

set -euo pipefail
PYTHON=.venv/bin/python
if [ ! -x "$PYTHON" ]; then PYTHON=$(command -v python3); fi
"$PYTHON" -m py_compile scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py
"$PYTHON" -m pytest -q tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py
"$PYTHON" scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py --help >/dev/null
if [ -f /tmp/stage28e_h_v7_corrected_parser_v1.log ]; then
  "$PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path
script = Path('scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent_replay_v2', script)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
accepted = timer_off = unsafe_accepted = 0
for line in Path('/tmp/stage28e_h_v7_corrected_parser_v1.log').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
    if not module.is_stage28d_output_line(line):
        continue
    values = dict(module.KV_RE.findall(line))
    state = module.output_state(values)
    if state is None:
        continue
    safety = int(state['safety']); force = int(state['force']); reason = int(state['reason'])
    clear = module.is_h_safety_clear(safety, force, reason)
    if clear:
        accepted += 1
        timer_off += int(reason == module.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_TIMER_OFF)
    unsafe_accepted += int(reason in (2,3,4,5) and clear)
assert accepted > 0
assert timer_off > 0
assert unsafe_accepted == 0
print(f'STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V2_REPLAY_PASS accepted={accepted} timer_off={timer_off}')
PY
else
  echo STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V2_REPLAY_SKIPPED log_missing=1
fi
git diff --check
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess

assert paths == expected, (paths, expected, status)
assert not any(path.endswith(('.c','.cc','.cpp','.h','.hpp')) for path in paths), paths
print('STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V2_DIFF_PASS')
PY
